parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user belongs.
> You can invoke [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user belongs.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user that you want to query.
> You can call [ListUsers](~~204522~~) to obtain this parameter.
